definitions.explanation: Information or updates from someone, especially someone far away.
Written communication, especially a personal letter.

examples.japanese: ⟦{息子|むすこ}→息子：00799_musuko⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{便|たよ}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: I received word from my son.

examples.japanese: ⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{便|たよ}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: To write a letter to a friend.

examples.japanese: ⟦{久|ひさ}しぶり→久しぶり：01711_hisashiburi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{故郷|ふるさと}→故郷：25466_furusato⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{便|たよ}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{届|とど}いた→届く：00899_todoku⟧。
examples.english: After a long time, I received a letter from my mother back home.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年賀状|ねんがじょう}→年賀状：06227_nengajou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{新年|しんねん}→新年：09787_shinnen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{便|たよ}り⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: New Year's cards are New Year's correspondence.

examples.japanese: ⟦{旅先|たびさき}→旅先：12949_tabisaki⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{便|たよ}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}った→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
examples.english: I sent a letter from my travel destination.

notes:
COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {便|たよ}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (to receive news/a letter)
- {便|たよ}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (no news, no word)
- {便|たよ}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ (to send a letter/news)

PROVERB:
- {便|たよ}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧{便|たよ}り: No news is good news

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {便|たよ}り: News/letter (slightly literary/traditional)
- ⟦{手紙|てがみ}→手紙：00675_tegami⟧: Letter (most common word)
- ⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧: Contact, communication (modern/practical)

NOTE: Though somewhat old-fashioned, {便|たよ}り is still used especially when referring to news from people far away or occasional correspondence.
